The Shattered Flask That Saved Millions

Imagine a world where car accidents meant flying glass shards, and every window was a potential weapon. One simple lab mishap changed everything. Discover how a French chemist's accidental observation revolutionized safety worldwide. 🧪 What everyday inventions do we owe to chance?
